answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by anchoring identity to verifiable computational work bonded through cryptographic staked collateral. Akin to an atlas holding a heavy load, the network forces every node to map its validity against a fluctuating tide of valid economic transactions. If a malicious cluster attempts to spawn fake identities, the deterministic slashing conditions act like a bending willow, absorbing the attack vector by automatically burning the attacker's staked capital and preserving system integrity without central authority.
